main.description: A shareable link, minted by a team member for a specific session. Redeeming it always grants session access, and conditionally grants team membership per joinPolicy.

joinPolicy.description: 'open': redeeming this invite grants team membership. 'membersOnly': redeeming grants session access only, and requires the redeemer to already be a team member.

createdBy.description: The member who minted this invite.
